policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="initObj" value="@{
			JObject initObj = new JObject();

			JObject loadedThrottleState = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("throttleState", null);
			JObject throttleMap = loadedThrottleState != null &&
				loadedThrottleState["backends"] != null &&
				loadedThrottleState["backends"].Type == JTokenType.Object
				? (JObject)loadedThrottleState["backends"]
				: new JObject();
			initObj["throttleState"] = new JObject {
				["dirty"] = false,
				["backends"] = throttleMap
			};

			JArray backends = (JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"];
			DateTime now = DateTime.UtcNow;
			foreach (JObject backend in backends) {
				DateTime wakeAt = throttleMap.Value(backend.Value("affinity")) ?? DateTime.MinValue;
				bool isThrottling = wakeAt > now;
				backend["isThrottling"] = isThrottling;
				backend["retryAfter"] = isThrottling ? wakeAt : DateTime.MinValue;
			}
			initObj["listBackends"] = backends;

			const int defaultPriority = 3;
			string priorityHeaderName = (string)context.Variables["priorityHeaderName"];
			int requestPriority = defaultPriority;
			if (context.Request.Headers.TryGetValue(priorityHeaderName, out var requestPriorityValues) &&
				int.TryParse(requestPriorityValues.FirstOrDefault(), out int parsedPriority) &&
				parsedPriority >= 1 && parsedPriority <= 3) {
				requestPriority = parsedPriority;
			}
			initObj["RequestPriority"] = requestPriority;

			string affinityHeaderName = (string)context.Variables["AffinityHeaderName"];
			string affinityHeader = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault(affinityHeaderName, "");
			int affinityBackendIdx = -1;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(affinityHeader)) {
				for (int i = 0; i < backends.Count; i++) {
					JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
					if (string.Equals(backend.Value("affinity"), affinityHeader, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
						affinityBackendIdx = i;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			initObj["RequestAddBackend"] = affinityBackendIdx;

			JArray priorityBackendIndxs = new JArray();
			for (int i = 0; i < backends.Count; i++) {
				JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
				if (backend["acceptablePriorities"]?.Values().Contains(requestPriority) == true) {
					priorityBackendIndxs.Add(i);
				}
			}
			initObj["PriBackendIndxs"] = priorityBackendIndxs;

			JObject priorityConfig = ((JObject)context.Variables["priorityCfg"])[requestPriority.ToString()] as JObject;
			int retryCount = priorityConfig?.Value("retryCount") ?? 1;
			bool requeueAllowed = priorityConfig?.Value("requeue") ?? true;
			initObj["RetryCount"] = retryCount;
			initObj["RequeueAllowed"] = requeueAllowed;
			initObj["backendCallCounter"] = 0;

			string policyCycleCounterHeaderName = (string)context.Variables["PolicyCycleCounterHeaderName"];
			int policyCycleCounter = 0;
			if (context.Request.Headers.TryGetValue(policyCycleCounterHeaderName, out var policyCycleValues) &&
				int.TryParse(policyCycleValues.FirstOrDefault(), out int parsedCounter)) {
				policyCycleCounter = parsedCounter;
			}
			initObj["PolicyCycleCounter"] = policyCycleCounter;

			JArray lastPolicyError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("lastPolicyError", new JArray());
			lastPolicyError.Clear();
			lastPolicyError.Add(new JObject {
				["code"] = "init",
				["message"] = "noError"
			});
			initObj["lastPolicyError"] = lastPolicyError;
			initObj["cntxWindowExced"] = false;

			JArray activityLog = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
			activityLog.Clear();
			activityLog.Add(new JObject {
				["Elapsed"] = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3"),
				["message"] = "Begin"
			});
			initObj["activityLog"] = activityLog;

			string dbgStr = "";
			var headers = context.Request.Headers;
			if (string.Equals(headers.GetValueOrDefault("S7PDEBUG", ""), "true", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
				JObject dbgObj = new JObject {
					["Proxy-Queue-Duration"] = headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-Request-Queue-Duration", "N/A"),
					["Proxy-Process-Duration"] = headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-Request-Process-Duration", "N/A"),
					["S7PID"] = headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-S7P-ID", "N/A"),
					[priorityHeaderName] = headers.GetValueOrDefault(priorityHeaderName, "N/A"),
					["Priority"] = requestPriority,
					["RequeueAllowed"] = requeueAllowed
				};
				dbgStr = string.Join(" | ", dbgObj.Properties().Select(p => p.Name + ": " + p.Value));
			}
			initObj["DbgStr"] = dbgStr;

			return initObj;
		}" />
		
		
		
		<set-variable name="RequestPriority" 	value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"]).Value("RequestPriority"))" />
		<set-variable name="RequestAddBackend" 	value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"]).Value("RequestAddBackend"))" />
		
		<set-variable name="RetryCount" 		value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"]).Value("RetryCount"))" />
		<set-variable name="RequeueAllowed" 	value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"]).Value("RequeueAllowed"))" />
		<set-variable name="backendCallCounter" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"]).Value("backendCallCounter"))" />
		<set-variable name="PolicyCycleCounter" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"]).Value("PolicyCycleCounter"))" />
		
		<set-variable name="cntxWindowExced" 	value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"]).Value("cntxWindowExced"))" />
		
		<set-variable name="DbgStr" 			value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["initObj"]).Value("DbgStr"))" />

		
		
			<when condition="@(((JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"]).Any(backend => string.Equals(((JObject)backend).Value("auth"), "MI", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))">
policies.backend:
<retry condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryRemaining", true))" count="50" interval="1" delta="1">
			<set-variable name="PolicyCycleCounter" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("PolicyCycleCounter") + 1)" />
			
			
			<set-variable name="throttleState" value="@{
				JObject loaded = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("throttleState", null);
				JObject map = (loaded != null && loaded["backends"] != null && loaded["backends"].Type == JTokenType.Object) ? (JObject)loaded["backends"] : new JObject();
				return new JObject { ["dirty"] = false, ["backends"] = map };
			}" />
			<set-variable name="listBackends" value="@{
				JArray backends = (JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"];
				JObject state = (JObject)((JObject)context.Variables["throttleState"])["backends"];
				DateTime now = DateTime.UtcNow;
				foreach (JObject b in backends) {
					DateTime wakeAt = state.Value(b.Value("affinity")) ?? DateTime.MinValue;
					bool isThrottling = wakeAt > now;
					b["isThrottling"] = isThrottling;
					b["retryAfter"] = isThrottling ? wakeAt : DateTime.MinValue;
				}
				return backends;
			}" />

			
			<set-variable name="ErrorScenario" value="@{
				// Error Scenario
				JArray backends = (JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"];
				JArray priorityBackendIndxs = (JArray)context.Variables["PriBackendIndxs"];
				JObject wrapper = (JObject)context.Variables["throttleState"];
				JObject state = (JObject)wrapper["backends"];
				var backendIndex = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendIndex", -1);
				var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
				var elapsedStr = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3");
				var callAttempted = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("callAttempted", false);
				DateTime now = DateTime.UtcNow;
				if ( backendIndex < 0 || backendIndex >= backends.Count) {

					if ( callAttempted ) {
						arr.Add(new JObject {{ "Elapsed", elapsedStr },{ "message", $"Invalid backend index: {backendIndex}" }});
					} else {
						var throttled = new List();

						foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
							JObject b = (JObject)backends[i];
							if (!b.Value("isThrottling")) {
								continue;
							}

							DateTime retryAfter = b.Value("retryAfter");
							var remainingSeconds = retryAfter > now
								? (int)Math.Ceiling((retryAfter - now).TotalSeconds)
								: 0;
							var retryAfterText = string.Format("{0:00}:{1:00}", remainingSeconds / 60, remainingSeconds % 60);
							throttled.Add(b.Value("label") + " - " + retryAfterText);
						}

						string msg = "THROTTLED: (" + (throttled.Count > 0 ? string.Join(", ", throttled) : "none") + ")";

						arr.Add(new JObject {{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") },{ "message", msg }});
					}
					return 4; // unknown
				}

				JObject backend = (JObject)backends[backendIndex];
				var lastStatusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 0;
				var callCompleted = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("callCompleted", true);
				var wasLimited = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("wasLimited", false);
				var startTime = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("CallAttemptStartTime", now);
				var deltaSeconds = (now - startTime).TotalSeconds;
				var requestTimeout = backend.Value("timeout");
				bool likelyTimeout = deltaSeconds >= (requestTimeout * 0.9);
				string label = backend.Value("label");
				string id = backend.Value("affinity");

				if ( callCompleted ) {
					return lastStatusCode >= 200 && lastStatusCode < 400 ? 0 : 1;
				}

				if ( likelyTimeout || wasLimited || lastStatusCode >= 500 ) {
					// Not completed with a throttle-worthy signal: record in the shared map (by id)
					DateTime wakeAt = now.AddSeconds(10);
					DateTime existingWake = state.Value(id) ?? DateTime.MinValue;
					if (wakeAt > existingWake) { state[id] = wakeAt; wrapper["dirty"] = true; }
					backend["isThrottling"] = true;
					backend["retryAfter"] = state.Value(id) ?? wakeAt;
				}

				int scenario;
				string message;
				if ( likelyTimeout) {
					scenario = 2; // timeout
					message = $"Throttling {label} by 10s, likely timeout Elapsed: {deltaSeconds:F1}s Timeout: {requestTimeout}s";
				} else if ( wasLimited ) {
					scenario = 3; // concurrency limit
					message = $"Throttling {label} by 10s, concurrency limit";
				} else if ( lastStatusCode >= 500 ) {
					scenario = 1; // error
					message = $"Throttling {label} by 10s, status {lastStatusCode}";
				} else {
					scenario = 4; // unknown
					message = $"Error status {lastStatusCode} after {deltaSeconds:F1}s";
				}

				arr.Add(new JObject {{ "Elapsed", elapsedStr },{ "message", message }});
				return scenario;
			}" />
			
			
				<when condition="@(((JObject)context.Variables["throttleState"]).Value("dirty"))">
					
				
			

			
			<set-variable name="backendIndex" value="@{
				try {
					JArray backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("listBackends", new JArray());
					JArray priorityBackendIndxs = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("PriBackendIndxs", new JArray());
					if (backends.Count == 0 || priorityBackendIndxs.Count == 0) { return -1; }

					bool cntxWindowExced = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("cntxWindowExced", false);
					int backendCallCount = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendCallCounter", 0);
					if (backendCallCount == 0 && !cntxWindowExced) {
						int affinityBackendIdx = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RequestAddBackend", -1);
						if (affinityBackendIdx >= 0 && affinityBackendIdx < backends.Count) {
							JObject affinityBackend = (JObject)backends[affinityBackendIdx];
							if (!affinityBackend.Value("isThrottling")) {
								return affinityBackendIdx;
							}
						}
					}

					var availableBackends = new List();
					int lowestPriority = int.MaxValue;
					foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
						JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
						if (backend.Value("isThrottling") || (cntxWindowExced && backend.Value("label") == "PTU")) {
							continue;
						}

						int priority = backend.Value("priorityGroup");
						if (priority > lowestPriority) {
							continue;
						}

						if (priority < lowestPriority) {
							lowestPriority = priority;
							availableBackends.Clear();
						}

						availableBackends.Add(i);
					}

					return availableBackends.Count == 0
						? -1
						: availableBackends[new Random(context.RequestId.GetHashCode()).Next(availableBackends.Count)];
				} catch (Exception ex) {
					var errArr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("lastPolicyError", null);
					if (errArr != null) {
						errArr.Clear();
						var msg = ex.Message ?? "Exception has no Message";
						if (msg.Length > 300) {
							msg = msg.Substring(0, 300) + "...";
						}
						errArr.Add(new JObject {
							{ "code", "backendIndex-update" },
							{ "message", msg },
							{ "utc", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o") }
						});
					}

					return -1;
				}


			}" />
			<set-variable name="shouldLimit" value="@{
				try {
				// Check if the backend should limit concurrency
				JArray backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("listBackends", new JArray());
				int backendIndex = (int)context.Variables["backendIndex"];
				if (backendIndex < 0 || backendIndex >= backends.Count) { return "off"; }
				JObject backend = (JObject)backends[backendIndex];
				return backend.Value("limitConcurrency");
				} catch (Exception ex) {
					var errArr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("lastPolicyError", null);
					if (errArr != null) {
						errArr.Clear();
						var msg = ex.Message ?? "Exception has no Message";
						if (msg.Length > 300) { msg = msg.Substring(0,300) + "..."; }
						errArr.Add(new JObject {
							{ "code", "shouldLimit-update" },
							{ "message", msg },
							{ "utc", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o") }
						});
					}
					return "off";
				}
			}" />
			
			<set-variable name="activityLog" value="@{
				var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
				var backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("listBackends", new JArray());
				var priorityBackendIndxs = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("PriBackendIndxs", new JArray());
				bool cntxWindowExced = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("cntxWindowExced", false);
				int unthrottledCount = 0;
				foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
					JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
					if (!backend.Value("isThrottling") && (!cntxWindowExced || backend.Value("label") != "PTU")) {
						unthrottledCount++;
					}
				}

				int remainingRetries = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryCount");
				int policyCycle = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("PolicyCycleCounter");
				var retryState = remainingRetries == 0 ? "exhausted" : remainingRetries.ToString();
				arr.Add(new JObject {
					{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3")},
					{ "message", $"RETRIES LEFT: {retryState} CYCLE: {policyCycle} Unthrottled Backends: {unthrottledCount}" }
				});
				return arr;
			}" />

			
			
			
				<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendIndex", 0) > -1 && context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryCount") > 0)">
					
					<set-variable name="RetryCount" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryCount") - 1)" />
					
					<set-variable name="RequestTimeout" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectedBackend"]).Value("timeout"))" />
					<set-variable name="backendUrl" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectedBackend"]).Value("url"))" />
					<set-variable name="auth" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectedBackend"]).Value("auth"))" />
					<set-variable name="backendCallCounter" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendCallCounter") + 1)" />
					
					
					
					
					
					
					
						<when condition="@(string.Equals(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("auth", ""), "MI", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))">
							
								@("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["managed-id-access-token"])
							
						
						<when condition="@(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("auth", "")))">
							
								@((string)context.Variables["auth"])
							
						
						
							
						
					
					<set-variable name="activityLog" value="@{
						// Backend Selected
						var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
						int index = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendIndex", 0);
						JObject backend = (JObject)((JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"])[index];
						arr.Add(new JObject {
							{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") },
							{ "message", "Using " + backend.Value("label") + " URL: " + backend.Value("url") +
								" LIMIT: " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") }
						});
						return arr;
					}" />
					

					
					
					
					
					
					<set-variable name="concurrencyKey" value="@{
						string requestedModel = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("model", "");
						JObject catalog = (JObject)context.Variables["backendCatalog"];
						JObject configuredBackends = string.IsNullOrEmpty(requestedModel) ? null : catalog[requestedModel] as JObject;
						string effectiveModel = configuredBackends != null && configuredBackends.Count > 0 ? requestedModel : "DEFAULT";
						string backendId = ((JObject)context.Variables["selectedBackend"]).Value("affinity");
						return context.Api.Id + ":" + effectiveModel + ":" + backendId;
					}" />
					
						<when condition="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectedBackend"]).Value("bufferResponse"))">
							
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "low")">
									
										
									
								
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "medium")">
									
										
									
								
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "high")">
									
										
									
								
								
									
									
								
							
						
						
							
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "low")">
									
										
									
								
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "medium")">
									
										
									
								
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "high")">
									
										
									
								
								
									
									
								
							
						
					
					
					

					
					
					
					<set-variable name="isPermError" value="@{
						var isTempError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isTempError", false);
						var statusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 500;
						bool isPermError = !isTempError && statusCode >= 400 && statusCode < 500;
						return isPermError;
					}" />
					<set-variable name="activityLog" value="@{
						// Response Classified
						var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
						var statusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode.ToString() ?? "N/A";
						var isPermError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isPermError", false);
						var isTempError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isTempError", false);
						if (isTempError) {
							return arr;
						}

						var statusSummary = isTempError ? "Temp Error" : (isPermError ? "Perm Error" : "Success");
						arr.Add(new JObject {
							{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") },
							{ "message", "StatusCode: " + statusCode + " - " + statusSummary }
						});
						return arr;
					}" />
				
				
					
					<set-variable name="activityLog" value="@{
						// No Backend
						var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
						var priorityBackendIndxs = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("PriBackendIndxs", new JArray());
						int retryCount = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryCount", 0);
						string message;

						if (priorityBackendIndxs.Count == 0) {
							message = "NO BACKENDS: none configured for priority " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RequestPriority", 3);
						} else if (retryCount <= 0) {
							message = "NO BACKENDS: retries exhausted";
						} else {
							var backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("listBackends", new JArray());
							bool cntxWindowExced = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("cntxWindowExced", false);
							var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
							var throttled = new List();
							foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
								JObject b = (JObject)backends[i];
								if (cntxWindowExced && b.Value("label") == "PTU") { continue; }
								if (!b.Value("isThrottling")) { continue; }
								var retryAfter = b.Value("retryAfter");
								var secs = retryAfter > now ? (int)Math.Ceiling((retryAfter - now).TotalSeconds) : 0;
								throttled.Add(b.Value("label") + " - " + string.Format("{0:00}:{1:00}", secs / 60, secs % 60));
							}
							message = "NO BACKENDS: all throttled (" + (throttled.Count > 0 ? string.Join(", ", throttled) : "none") + ")";
						}

						arr.Add(new JObject {
							{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") },
							{ "message", message }
						});
						return arr;
					}" />
				
			
			
			<set-variable name="cntxWindowExced" value="@{
				if (context.Response == null) { return context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("cntxWindowExced", false); }
				
				int statusCode = context.Response.StatusCode;
				
				if (statusCode == 400) {
					try {
						var body = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
						var errorCode = body["error"]?["code"]?.ToString();
						
						if (errorCode == "context_length_exceeded") {
							return true;
						}
					} catch { }
				}
				
				// Keep existing value if not a context window error
				return context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("cntxWindowExced", false);
			}" />

			
			<set-variable name="isPermError" value="@{
				if (context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("cntxWindowExced", false)) {
					var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
					arr.Add(new JObject {
						{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") },
						{ "message", "CONTEXT WINDOW EXCEEDED: overriding 400, retrying on next host" }
					});
					return false;
				}
				return context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isPermError", false);
			}" />

			
				<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendIndex", -1) > -1 &&
					(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isTempError", true) ||
					(!context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("callCompleted", true) &&
						(new[] { 429, 408 }.Contains(context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 0) ||
						(context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 0) >= 500))))">
					
					<set-variable name="throttleState" value="@{
						JObject loaded = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("throttleState", null);
						JObject map = (loaded != null && loaded["backends"] != null && loaded["backends"].Type == JTokenType.Object) ? (JObject)loaded["backends"] : new JObject();
						JObject wrapper = new JObject { ["dirty"] = false, ["backends"] = map };
						JArray backends = (JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"];
						int idx = (int)context.Variables["backendIndex"];
						if (idx < 0 || idx >= backends.Count) { return wrapper; }
						JObject backend = (JObject)backends[idx];
						string id = backend.Value("affinity");

						// Prefer Azure OpenAI milliseconds, then standard seconds, then the backend default.
						double retryAfterMilliseconds = backend["defaultRetryAfter"].Value() * 1000.0;
						string retryAfterMsHeader = context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("retry-after-ms", "");
						if (int.TryParse(retryAfterMsHeader, out int parsedMilliseconds) && parsedMilliseconds > 0) {
							retryAfterMilliseconds = parsedMilliseconds + 2000.0;
						} else {
							string retryAfterHeader = context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("retry-after", "");
							if (int.TryParse(retryAfterHeader, out int parsedSeconds) && parsedSeconds > 0) {
								retryAfterMilliseconds = (parsedSeconds + 2) * 1000.0;
							}
						}

						// Multi-process safe: keep the max wake time for this backend id
						DateTime newWake = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMilliseconds(retryAfterMilliseconds);
						DateTime existing = (map[id] != null && map[id].Type != JTokenType.Null) ? map[id].Value() : DateTime.MinValue;
						if (newWake > existing) { map[id] = newWake; wrapper["dirty"] = true; }

						DateTime effective = map[id].Value();
						backend["isThrottling"] = true;
						backend["retryAfter"] = effective;

						var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
						var remainingSeconds = effective > DateTime.UtcNow ? (int)Math.Ceiling((effective - DateTime.UtcNow).TotalSeconds) : 0;
						var retryAfterText = string.Format("{0:00}:{1:00}", remainingSeconds / 60, remainingSeconds % 60);
						var statusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode.ToString() ?? "N/A";
						arr.Add(new JObject {
							{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") },

						});

					}" />
					
						<when condition="@(((JObject)context.Variables["throttleState"]).Value("dirty"))">
							
						
					
				
			
			<set-variable name="unThrottledBackends" value="@{

				var priorityBackendIndxs = (JArray)context.Variables["PriBackendIndxs"];
				bool cntxWindowExced = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("cntxWindowExced", false);
				int count=0;
				foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {

					if (cntxWindowExced && backend.Value("label") == "PTU") {

						count++;
					}
				}

			<set-variable name="RetryRemaining" value="@{
				var isPermError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isPermError", false);
				var retryCount = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryCount", -1);
				var unthrottled = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("unThrottledBackends", 0);
				var RequeueAllowed = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RequeueAllowed", true);
				var proxyWillRequeue = RequeueAllowed && (unthrottled == 0);

				// retryCount has already been decremented for the attempt just made.
				return (!isPermError && retryCount > 0) && !proxyWillRequeue;
			}" />

			<set-variable name="Return429" value="@{
				var isPermError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isPermError", false);
				var RetryRemaining = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryRemaining", true);
				var RequeueAllowed = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RequeueAllowed", true);

			<set-variable name="activityLog" value="@{
				// Retry Decision
				var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
				if (!context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("Return429", false)) {
					return arr;
				}

				var backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("listBackends", new JArray());
				var priorityBackendIndxs = (JArray)context.Variables["PriBackendIndxs"];
				var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
				var parts = new List(priorityBackendIndxs.Count);
				foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
					if (i < 0 || i >= backends.Count) { continue; }
					JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
					string label = backend.Value("label");
					if (!backend.Value("isThrottling")) {
						parts.Add(label + " ready");
						continue;
					}

					DateTime retryAfter = backend.Value("retryAfter");
					int secs = retryAfter > now ? (int)Math.Ceiling((retryAfter - now).TotalSeconds) : 0;
					parts.Add(label + " " + string.Format("{0:00}:{1:00}", secs / 60, secs % 60));
				}

				arr.Add(new JObject {
					{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") },
					{ "message", "REQUEUE: RequeueAllowed=" + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RequeueAllowed", true) + "; " + string.Join(", ", parts) }
				});
				return arr;
			}" />

policies.on-error:
<set-variable name="onErrorObj" value="@{
			JObject onErrorObj = new JObject();
			JObject responseObj = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("responseObject", new JObject());
			JArray activityLog = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
			int statusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 500;
			bool callCompleted = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("callCompleted", false);
			int backendIndex = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendIndex", -1);
			bool isTempError = statusCode == 429 || statusCode == 408 || statusCode >= 500;
			bool isPermError = !isTempError && statusCode >= 400 && statusCode < 500;

			string lastErrorReason = context.LastError?.Reason ?? "";
			string lastErrorMessage = context.LastError?.Message ?? "";
			if (lastErrorMessage.Length > 200) {
				lastErrorMessage = lastErrorMessage.Substring(0, 200) + "...";
			}

			activityLog.Add(new JObject {
				["Elapsed"] = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3"),
				["message"] = "ON ERROR ENTERED: callCompleted: " + callCompleted +
					" backendIndex: " + backendIndex +
					" unThrottledBackends: " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("unThrottledBackends", -1) +
					" RetryRemaining: " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryRemaining", true) +
					" Return429: " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("Return429", false) +
					" LastError: " + lastErrorReason + " - " + lastErrorMessage
			});

			bool includeHandlerLog = true;
			if (callCompleted) {
				responseObj["statusCode"] = isPermError || isTempError ? statusCode : 500;
				responseObj["statusReason"] = isPermError
					? "Permanent Error"
					: (isTempError ? "Temporary Error" : "Unknown Error");
			} else {
				JArray backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("listBackends", new JArray());
				JArray priorityBackendIndxs = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("PriBackendIndxs", new JArray());
				bool cntxWindowExced = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("cntxWindowExced", false);
				int unthrottledBackends = 0;

				foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
					if (i < 0 || i >= backends.Count) { continue; }
					JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
					if (cntxWindowExced && backend.Value("label") == "PTU") { continue; }
					if (!backend.Value("isThrottling")) { unthrottledBackends++; }
				}

				if (unthrottledBackends == 0) {
					responseObj["statusCode"] = 429;
					responseObj["statusReason"] = "No Backends Available";
					includeHandlerLog = false;
				} else if (backendIndex < 0 || backendIndex >= backends.Count) {
					responseObj["statusCode"] = 500;
					responseObj["statusReason"] = "Invalid Backend Index";
					includeHandlerLog = false;
				} else {
					bool wasLimited = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("wasLimited", false);
					DateTime startTime = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("CallAttemptStartTime", DateTime.UtcNow);
					double deltaSeconds = (DateTime.UtcNow - startTime).TotalSeconds;
					int requestTimeout = ((JObject)backends[backendIndex]).Value("timeout");
					bool likelyTimeout = deltaSeconds >= (requestTimeout * 0.9);

					if (likelyTimeout) {
						responseObj["statusCode"] = 408;
						responseObj["statusReason"] = "Timeout";
						statusCode = 408;
					} else if (wasLimited) {
						responseObj["statusCode"] = 429;
						responseObj["statusReason"] = "Concurrency Limit";
						statusCode = 429;
					} else {
						responseObj["statusCode"] = 500;
						responseObj["statusReason"] = "Unknown Error";
					}
				}
			}

			if (includeHandlerLog) {
				activityLog.Add(new JObject {
					["Elapsed"] = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3"),
					["message"] = "ON ERROR HANDLER INVOKED-  callCompleted: " + callCompleted +
						" isPermError: " + isPermError +
						" isTempError: " + isTempError +
						" StatusCode: " + statusCode
				});
			}

			string backendLog = string.Join(" | ", activityLog.Select(entry =>
				((JObject)entry).Value("Elapsed") + "s " + ((JObject)entry).Value("message")
			));
			if (backendLog.Length > 4000) {
				backendLog = backendLog.Substring(0, 4000) + "...";
			}

			JArray policyErrors = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("lastPolicyError", new JArray());
			onErrorObj["response"] = responseObj;
			onErrorObj["backendLog"] = backendLog;
			onErrorObj["lastPolicyError"] = policyErrors.Count == 0
				? ""
				: policyErrors.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
			onErrorObj["requeueAllowed"] = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RequeueAllowed", true);
			onErrorObj["retryAfterMs"] = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("sleepDuration", 10000);
			return onErrorObj;
		}" />

			reason="@(((JObject)context.Variables["responseObject"]).Value("statusReason"))" />
		@(((JObject)context.Variables["responseObject"]).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None))
		
			@(((JObject)context.Variables["onErrorObj"]).Value("backendLog"))
		
		
			@(((JObject)context.Variables["onErrorObj"]).Value("lastPolicyError"))
